record.title: Insert moulding — a stamped metal part encapsulated by the plastic that is moulded around it
record.why: The GEOMETRY is measured: each finger's root is cut out of the carrier solid with 0.020 mm of clearance, which is what the metal does to the plastic in the tool, and the interference check across all 45 pairs reads zero as a result. RETENTION — whether the LCP grips the finger through its working life and its thermal cycles — is CANNOT DETERMINE: no part has been moulded and no pull-out test has been run.

joins.a: a stamped metal insert (here a C5191 spring finger)
joins.b: the moulded feature that surrounds it (here a carrier spoke)

record.adds_parts_why: this joint consumes no part; it joins two. No fastener, and deliberately so — a screw would cost 1.5-2.5 mm of a 7.98 mm budget and put metal inside Apple's Ø37.31 antenna keep-out (DECISIONS.md D13).
record.standard_why: No pull-out or retention standard was fetched and none is claimed.
